dedupe_keys.name: city of san diego facilities condition assessment fci ratings of city buildings

description: San Diego publishes the Facility Condition Index (FCI) rating of each city-owned facility from a condition assessment of buildings, selected installed equipment and site systems; the FCI reflects the backlog cost of maintenance and capital needs relative to the building. The CSV has 703 rows with campus and building names and numbers, address, community area, council district and coordinates, forecast year, condition class, FCI, capital, maintenance and total requirement costs, age and year built, asset type and group, service level, building category, department, function, gross floor area, inspection and last renovation fiscal years, solar and accessibility survey flags, and text descriptions of the site, substructure, shell, interiors, plumbing, mechanical, life safety and electrical systems. Coverage: city facilities such as offices, work yards, libraries, recreation centres and public safety buildings. Access: free CSV and data dictionary. Licence: Open Data Commons PDDL. Caveats: a one-off assessment (the page was last updated July 2017), so conditions and costs are dated. Simulation uses: prioritising renewal of public buildings and representing condition in city asset management and resilience models. Related records: the San Diego development permits and the UK school estate condition data.
